description: Bulk zero-knowledge folder anchoring (10 to 5,000+ files in a single call): Hashes all files in a local folder 100% locally (0 file bytes uploaded), supports Biometric (Passkey) or Anonymous anchoring, skips any files that are already anchored (safe to resume), and keeps the user's folder clean by storing per-file Doomsday Proofs inside a single `_reltime_proofs/` subfolder plus a master `reltime-batch-manifest.json`.

anchor_mode.description: Use 'standard' (default) or 'temporal' (VDF T_index sequential ordering for Superhighway & Autonomous Agents).

artifact_mode.description: Controls local output files so bulk runs never clutter the folder: 'proofs_subfolder' (default) writes JSON proofs into `<folder>/_reltime_proofs/` + `reltime-batch-manifest.json`; 'manifest_only' writes only `reltime-batch-manifest.json`; 'full' also writes SVG Sun-Stamps and HTML certificates.

biometric.description: If true, performs Biometric Anchors using your linked hardware Passkey (`~/.reltime/passkey.json`) across the entire folder without repeated TouchID prompts.

concurrency.description: Number of concurrent anchor requests (default: 5, max: 10).

folder_path.description: Absolute path to the local directory to hash and anchor.

recursive.description: If true, recursively anchors files in subdirectories. Defaults to false (top-level files only).

name: reltime_anchor_folder
